intro: Cracker Barrel is a country-style restaurant and old-fashioned store best known for serving breakfast all day, from buttermilk pancakes to biscuits and gravy, alongside Southern dinner plates like Chicken N' Dumplins and Country Fried Steak. Every dinner comes with made-from-scratch country sides and warm biscuits or cornbread, which is why the plate price is close to what you pay. Below is the full Cracker Barrel menu with prices and calories for 2026, broken down by category.
quick_answer: Breakfast is served all day and starts around $8.99 for the Old Timer's Breakfast. Country dinner plates like Chicken N' Dumplins and Country Fried Steak run about $9.49 to $13.99 with sides. Weekday lunch combos start near $8.29, and Cracker Barrel lists more than 20 meals under $12.
hot_deal: Weekday lunch specials: Cracker Barrel runs daily lunch plates (meatloaf, Chicken N' Dumplins, turkey n' dressing and more) starting around $8.29 to $8.99, and keeps a rotating list of more than 20 meals under $12. Offers vary by location.

faqs.q: Does Cracker Barrel serve breakfast all day?
faqs.a: Yes. Cracker Barrel serves its full breakfast menu all day, every day, from pancakes and French toast to biscuits and gravy and the Old Timer's Breakfast.

faqs.q: What is Chicken N' Dumplins at Cracker Barrel?
faqs.a: Chicken N' Dumplins is Cracker Barrel's signature comfort dish: slow-simmered chicken with thick dumplings in a creamy broth, served with country sides. It is around $9.49 with two sides.

faqs.q: Does Cracker Barrel have cheap meals?
faqs.a: Yes. Cracker Barrel keeps a rotating list of more than 20 meals under $12, and weekday lunch combos start around $8.29. The Pick 2 Country Combos and daily lunch plates are the best value.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Cracker Barrel?
faqs.a: The best known are the Chicken N' Dumplins, the Hashbrown Casserole, Country Fried Steak, the Old Timer's Breakfast, and the Double Chocolate Fudge Coca-Cola Cake.

faqs.q: Do Cracker Barrel meals come with sides?
faqs.a: Yes. Most dinner plates come with your choice of made-from-scratch country sides plus warm buttermilk biscuits or sweet cornbread muffins.

faqs.q: Does Cracker Barrel have family meals to go?
faqs.a: Yes. Cracker Barrel offers family meals that serve about five people, starting around $36.99, including Chicken N' Dumplins, fried chicken and meatloaf, each with sides and bread.
